brief.ask: Art-direct "Gethsemane Olive Dusk" — #1 of the 72 Ambo church visualizers (Calm Contemporary Worship lyric visualizer, Collection I of 72; subgenre Scenic Nature). Premise: Ancient gnarled olive boughs, Jerusalem terrace stones, and lantern fireflies. Interactive code twin of the Gethsemane concept plate: gnarled thousand-year olive trunks, silver-sage foliage, terraced limestone walls, and hanging oil lanterns breathe with the singer’s voice. Lighting today: Key: 3200K warm oil-lantern glow + 5800K indigo twilight sky; rolling ground haze. Service use: Communion, Good Friday, intimate reflection, acoustic worship. Audio mapping today: Vocal → Brightens hanging oil lanterns, firefly halos & lyric glow; Swell → Lifts warm amber ground mist through ancient olive roots; Harmonic → Sways silver-green olive leaf clusters in the evening breeze. Palette: #09131E #1E3A4C #D49B42 #FAF3E3. Keep the id, name, premise and palette; rebuild the direction: the geometry and depth planes, typography for the worship lyric band (one line at a time, four to five seconds a line, word-by-word progression), image logic (how the Gemini concept plate it twins (/sanctuary-plates/calm-olive-gethsemane.jpg, blended in at plateBlend) and the procedural scene meet), texture, motion, and which audio channel drives what. Decide it — the lead's lens will drive the kit's material weave and optical pass for this one.
brief.audience: Congregations watching a projector or LED wall from the pews, five to forty metres away, eyes on the words; and the worship leader or volunteer running Ambo live from a laptop.
brief.feeling: Stillness and reverence — a sanctuary that breathes with the singer's voice; gorgeous, slow, never a screensaver.
constraints: Build method (fixed): a real-time Canvas 2D audio-reactive renderer in Plajah's worship visualizer kit — sanctuary background, multi-plane depth (god rays, motes, bokeh), the kit's Council optical pass (35mm light leaks, anamorphic flare, film grain, colour punch, and a tactile material weave keyed to the LEAD director's lens) and the kit's lyric / scripture typography engine. No video playback, no WebGL, no assets beyond the one concept plate.

Audio drives amplitude, colour, light, growth and glow only — never the position of the words. Envelopes are smoothed; nothing strobes or flashes (photosensitive-safe); uptempo pulses are spring-damped.

The reading band is sacred: lyrics or scripture must stay legible at 1920×1080 and 4K from the back pew, over the busiest moment of the scene. A text-safe dimming band is part of the kit; direct how the scene yields to it.

Typefaces are fixed to the kit's open-licensed set: Noto Serif (text serif), Outfit / Inter (sans), Cinzel (display), JetBrains Mono. Direct scale, case, tracking, measure and hierarchy, not new families.

Sacred imagery is used correctly and respectfully: biblical places and objects are specific and attributable, never costume; nothing denominational or branded; nothing that reads as a music video or a screensaver.
Runs at 60 fps on an integrated-GPU laptop driving a projector: favour layered gradients, cached textures and a few large shapes over particle storms.
Keep this visualizer's id, name, premise and four-colour palette. The council owns the direction, not the catalogue entry.
references: Concept plate: /sanctuary-plates/calm-olive-gethsemane.jpg — a Gemini art plate this visualizer was built as the interactive code twin of.
Sample lyric lines on the band: "Be still my soul the Lord is on thy side" / "Bear patiently the cross of grief or pain".

proposals.title: Stone, Bough, and Governed Light
proposals.idea: A single polar-origin lantern at 35° declares the cantus firmus before any content exists — every foil angle, every leaf sway interval, every amber mist rise, and every lyric glow derives from that one prior constraint, so the scene reads as a unified architectural act of light rather than an accumulation of atmospheric effects.
proposals.geometry: Three load-bearing depth planes stated at fixed proportions: ground plane occupying the lower 38.2% of frame (golden section, measured from bottom), mid-plane trunk silhouettes spanning 38.2%–76.4%, sky plane claiming the remaining 23.6% — a classical three-register elevation, not a cinematic rack-focus. The concept plate (calm-olive-gethsemane.jpg, blended at plateBlend) is composited as a fourth plane behind all procedural layers, its luminance channel extracted and used to seed bokeh mote positions so the procedural scene is spatially anchored to the plate's actual stone and bough geometry. God rays emanate from the declared 35° polar origin in the upper-right quadrant; shadow offsets on trunk silhouettes and stone courses are all cast at the reciprocal 215°. The text-safe dimming band occupies a fixed zone: a horizontal slab from y = 55% to y = 78% of frame height, its opacity govern
proposals.typography: Cinzel, capitals only, at a tracked measure of 0.18em — the display register for the lyric line, set at a scale that reads from 40 m: approximately 72px at 1080p, scaled proportionally at 4K. Word-by-word progression: each incoming word fades in over 180 ms with a simultaneous 2px upward translate that damps to rest by 220 ms — a spring arrival, not a pop. The completed line holds for the remainder of its 4–5 second slot; the exiting line dissolves over 320 ms. No word ever moves horizontally; position is locked at line-set time and never renegotiated by audio. A secondary scripture or song-title register sits 1.6× the Cinzel cap-height above the lyric line, set in Noto Serif Italic at 60% of lyric scale, tracking 0.06em, title-case — the counterpoint voice beneath the cantus firmus. Lyric glow is a warm amber (#D49B42 at 28% opacity) text-shadow spread of 18px, driven by vocal amplitude
proposals.imageLogic: The concept plate is loaded once at init, drawn to an offscreen canvas at native resolution, and composited as the rearmost plane using globalAlpha = plateBlend (a constant declared before render loop begins, default 0.72). Its luminance map is sampled on a 24×14 grid at load time; grid cells above a luminance threshold seed the fixed positions of bokeh mote and firefly halo objects — so every procedural glow inhabits a location the plate's actual painted light already authorises. The plate is never scaled, cropped, or panned during performance: it is the substrate, not the animation. Procedural layers are drawn over it in strict z-order: (1) ground haze gradient, (2) trunk silhouettes, (3) stone course texture fills, (4) god rays, (5) bokeh motes, (6) firefly halos, (7) lantern glows, (8) leaf clusters, (9) text-safe dimming band, (10) lyric/scripture band. The optical pass — 35mm light
proposals.texture: Stone courses in the ground plane are rendered as cached horizontal gradient bands — limestone #FAF3E3 at highlight, #1E3A4C at shadow — with a 1px vertical displacement every 18–22px (pseudo-random but seeded, so identical on every frame unless audio-driven growth changes the haze height). Trunk silhouettes are filled with a radial gradient from warm #D49B42 core to near-black #09131E bark edge, with a 2px structural offset applied to every silhouette's stroke path as a locked constant — the misregistration that proves the depth of the plane, not an error. Olive leaf clusters are drawn as cached sprite arrays of ellipses (silver-sage: #FAF3E3 at 60% opacity) grouped in clusters of 7–11, each cluster assigned a fixed pivot point; the pivot sways. Film grain is a pre-generated 512×512 noise tile, tiled and scrolled at 1px/frame on a diagonal — perceptible as material texture at close rang
proposals.motion: The entry sequence obeys the declared temporal hierarchy: background plate and ground plane arrive at 0 ms; trunk silhouettes and stone courses resolve at 600 ms; god rays and bokeh motes reach full opacity at 1400 ms; lanterns and firefly halos complete at 2000 ms; leaf clusters begin their ambient sway at 2200 ms. Nothing rushes the measure. Ambient motion thereafter: leaf clusters sway on a 3.8 s sinusoidal period (phase-offset per cluster by its index × 0.4 s); bokeh motes drift upward at 0.3–0.6 px/frame, wrapping at the top of their plane; firefly halos pulse on a 2.1 s breath cycle. Audio mapping: Vocal amplitude → lantern glow radius (base 28px, max 48px) and lyric text-shadow spread, smoothed over 80 ms; Swell → ground haze height (base 12% of frame, max 22%), amber mist opacity rising through olive roots, smoothed over 400 ms; Harmonic energy → leaf cluster sway amplitude multi
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D render loop at 60 fps. All assets procedural or derived from the single licensed concept plate. Offscreen canvases cache: (a) stone course texture tile, (b) trunk silhouette set, (c) leaf cluster sprite sheet, (d) film grain tile. God rays are drawn as a fan of fillRect strokes at low opacity with the 35° angle as the declared constant — no trigonometry recalculated per frame, only opacity modulated. Firefly halos are drawn as radialGradient circles at their seeded positions. The optical pass (light leak, flare, grain) is a single composited layer drawn once per frame from the cached tiles. All palette values, the 35° angle, the plateBlend constant, the temporal entry intervals, and the text-safe band boundaries are declared as named constants at the top of the module before any render function is defined — the cantus firmus is written before the voices enter.
proposals.humanTrace: The 35° polar origin was editorially chosen — not computed — by looking at the concept plate and identifying where the painted lantern light already establishes its strongest diagonal. The luminance-seeded bokeh positions mean every procedural glow is an act of reading the plate's painted light and honouring its judgment. The 2px structural offset on trunk silhouettes is a deliberate compositional decision, not a default. The leaf sway phase offsets are assigned by cluster index — a human-legible rule, not noise. The temporal entry sequence was timed against a spoken reading of the first lyric line to confirm that the scene is fully resolved before a word appears.
proposals.risk: The classical proportional structure — fixed planes, fixed text zone, a cantus firmus that never negotiates — will read as restraint to a congregation trained on fluid motion-graphics worship software. The risk is that 'still' becomes 'inert' if the audio reactivity is too subtle. That risk is worth carrying because the service contexts (Communion, Good Friday, intimate reflection) demand that the scene never upstage the singer or the word; a visualizer that could be accused of being a screensaver is doing its liturgical job. The governing constraint is the content.

arguesWith.why: The Baroque Dramatist will want the lantern halos to swell dramatically on the vocal peak and the god rays to bloom wide on the swell — a reveal that announces itself. I will hold that the reveal must be earned by proportion, not declared by amplitude: the god ray opacity ceiling is set low enough that even at full swell it does not overpower the stone and bough that frame it. proposals.title: Ink Pressed Into Stone
proposals.idea: The scene is not rendered — it is printed: each depth plane behaves like a successive pull from a reduction linocut, with lantern glow and leaf-sway as the ink that hasn't dried yet.
proposals.geometry: Three hard depth-registers, not a continuous fog gradient. Foreground: olive root mass, dark as a woodcut shadow, occupies the bottom 38% — irregular silhouette edge generated from a Perlin-displaced bezier, not a smooth curve, so it reads like a torn proof. Midground: terraced limestone wall band, roughly 28% of frame height, sits at the horizon of the foreground plane. Background: indigo sky dome with lantern hang-points distributed on a loose golden-ratio arc — not symmetrical, not random, weighted left-of-center the way a printmaker weights a composition by hand. The lyric band occupies a declared strip 19% from the bottom edge of the visible frame: this is the press registration mark, fixed before any other element is placed, the one measurement the whole run answers to.
proposals.typography: Noto Serif, set in lowercase with initial cap — never allcaps, never shouted. Size: 4.2vw at 1080p, scaling linearly to 4K. Tracking: +0.04em, loose enough to breathe, tight enough to hold across forty metres. Each word fades in over 180ms with a slight vertical rise of 3px — not a wipe, not a bounce, a breath. The line sits on the text-safe dimming band: a 14%-height gradient strip, #09131E at 72% opacity, blurred vertically 18px so it reads as atmospheric settling rather than a UI rectangle. Active word: #FAF3E3 at full luminance. Preceding words in the line: #FAF3E3 at 55%. Scripture reference, when present: Cinzel, 1.6vw, tracked +0.12em, #D49B42 — appears only after the lyric line completes, fades out before the next line enters. No weight heavier than regular for Noto Serif in this context; the congregation is already carrying weight.
proposals.imageLogic: The concept plate /sanctuary-plates/calm-olive-gethsemane.jpg enters at plateBlend, drawn beneath all procedural planes as the base luminance map — it is never the scene, it is the memory of the scene. Blend mode: multiply, opacity 0.38 at rest, rising to 0.52 on swell peak. The plate is desaturated 40% before blending so its photographic specificity does not compete with the procedural ink-register logic; what survives is its tonal geography — where the plate is dark, the procedural planes deepen; where it carries lantern warmth, the generative glow finds a bed to land in. The plate is never panned or zoomed; it is fixed, a press bed. The procedural scene moves above it.
proposals.texture: Paper tooth: a single full-frame cached noise texture (512×512, tiled, generated once at load from a seeded Perlin field) sits at screen-multiply blend, opacity 8% — invisible at distance, perceptible at arm's length on a monitor, which is where the operator lives. Ink bleed: the olive silhouette edge carries a 2px feathered outer glow in #09131E that pulses 0–3px on swell, simulating ink spread under pressure. Lanterns: each lantern is a procedural ellipse with a radial gradient core (#D49B42 → transparent); the gradient radius breathes at 0.3–1.8 Hz non-looping Perlin oscillation keyed to the declared 35° light source azimuth — the highlight vector does not drift, the intensity does. Firefly halos: small (r: 3–7px) luminous points distributed within the midground band, each on an independent slow drift path (Lissajous variant, period 8–22s); they are not particles fired from an emitter
proposals.motion: Order of motion, slowest to fastest — this is the hierarchy of breath. 1. Indigo sky: imperceptible slow gradient shift, #1E3A4C to #09131E, cycling 90s, driven by nothing except time — it is the one thing that does not answer to the singer. 2. Leaf clusters: silver-sage foliage shapes (cached bezier paths, pre-computed at load, 6–9 clusters) sway on harmonic amplitude — angular offset ±4° over 2.8s eased sine, damped so a sudden silence decays over 1.4s not instantly. 3. Ground haze: a radial gradient (#D49B42 at 0% → #1E3A4C at 100%) anchored at root-mass level; on swell, its inner radius expands from 0px to 180px over 600ms spring-damped, then contracts over 1200ms — amber warmth lifts through roots, falls back. 4. Lantern glow and firefly halos: on vocal amplitude, each lantern's gradient radius scales 1.0×–1.35× over 80ms, eased out; firefly halos scale 0.8×–1.6×; lyric glow (text s
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D renderer. Load sequence: (1) seed Perlin field, cache paper-tooth texture, cache olive silhouette bezier paths, cache leaf-cluster paths, cache lantern ellipse positions on golden-ratio arc, cache firefly Lissajous offsets — all at init, nothing computed per-frame that can be pre-baked. (2) Draw order per frame: sky gradient → plate blend (drawImage, multiply) → god-ray shafts (radial gradient stripes from lantern positions, low opacity) → ground haze radial → olive root silhouette → limestone wall band → leaf clusters → lantern ellipses with glow → firefly points → paper-tooth overlay → film grain pass → text-safe dimming band → lyric type → scripture type. Audio envelopes: three smoothed signals (vocal, swell, harmonic), each low-pass filtered at 8Hz update rate — no strobe, no flash. All generative assets produced by prompted image model for the concept plate; all procedural
proposals.humanTrace: The olive silhouette edge is Perlin-displaced along its upper contour with a seed that is declared in the kit config before the first frame renders — that seed is the registration mark, the one prior human decision the whole run answers to. Change the seed and you change the silhouette; the seed is chosen editorially, not algorithmically optimised. The paper-tooth tile carries a fixed grain direction (bias toward 15° diagonal) that was set as a config constant. These are not accidents; they are the equivalent of a printmaker's pressure decision — made once, committed, visible in every pull.
proposals.risk: This direction refuses the atmospheric render that every other worship visualizer reaches for. The hard depth-register logic risks reading as graphic and cold in a context that expects warmth and seamless depth. That risk is worth carrying because the hard register is exactly what makes the scene feel made — a continuous fog gradient is ambient; a torn silhouette edge is a mark. If the congregation feels the weight of the stone planes, the lantern warmth lands against something real. Screensavers have no edges.

arguesWith.why: The Baroque Dramatist will want to dissolve the depth registers into volumetric atmosphere — let the haze unify all planes, let the lantern light bloom across the whole frame. proposals.title: Light Axiom at 3200K
proposals.idea: A single declared light source at upper-left 28°/18° becomes the generative contract from which every downstream parameter — lantern bloom radius, haze lift rate, leaf sway phase, lyric glow, foil shimmer vector — is derived as a computable consequence, never an aesthetic guess.
proposals.geometry: Three strict depth planes established as canvas layers at fixed z-indices: GROUND (0–38% canvas height, terraced limestone silhouette, haze domain), MID (22–72%, olive trunk columns at irrational intervals derived from the golden angle 137.5°, lanterns hung at trunk-intersection nodes), SKY (58–100%, indigo-to-near-black gradient, firefly domain). No horizon line is drawn — the planes overlap in a computed blur-radius gradient so depth reads as atmospheric falloff, not a painted backdrop. Lyric band occupies a protected horizontal slot at 68–82% canvas height, always above the ground haze, always below the canopy bokeh. Text-safe dimming band is a gaussian-feathered rectangle 12% taller than the type cap-height, luminance clamped to ≤18% of background at its centre, computed per-frame against current scene brightness — the scene yields to the word, not the other way around.
proposals.typography: Noto Serif at 52px / 3.25rem base (scales linearly with canvas width); uppercase false; tracking +0.04em; measure locked to 68% canvas width centred. Word-by-word reveal: each word fades in over 280ms (ease-out cubic), previous words drop to 55% opacity and shift left 2px to signal progression without motion sickness — position is fixed, only luminance and opacity are audio-reactive. Active word receives a warm amber (#D49B42) text-shadow at 0 0 18px, bloom radius a direct linear output of vocal amplitude (range: 8px–28px, spring-damped τ=0.18s). Line transition: outgoing line dissolves on a 400ms opacity ramp; incoming line arrives 120ms after outgoing fully clears — no overlap, no simultaneous text. Cinzel used exclusively for scripture reference slug below the lyric band at 13px, spaced +0.22em, all-caps, opacity 0.45 — present but subordinate.
proposals.imageLogic: The concept plate /sanctuary-plates/calm-olive-gethsemane.jpg is loaded once at init into an offscreen canvas, desaturated 40% via CSS filter before compositing, and drawn into the SKY and MID planes at plateBlend (operator: multiply, global alpha 0.28–0.42). The blend value is a continuous output of harmonic amplitude — stronger harmonic content lifts plateBlend toward 0.42, making the photographic plate more present as the music swells with texture; silence drops it to 0.28 so the procedural scene reads as primary. The plate never occupies the GROUND plane; a linear mask (transparent at 38% canvas height, fully opaque at 55%) prevents the photographic stone texture from competing with the haze simulation. The plate is treated as a light-field reference, not an illustration — its trunk forms inform where procedural trunk silhouettes are placed, but they are redrawn as Canvas 2D Bezier s
proposals.texture: Material weave is the Futurist lens: simulated optical glass, not woven cloth. The council optical pass delivers: (1) 35mm grain — a pre-rendered 512×512 tileable noise canvas, composited at globalAlpha 0.045, scrolled 1px/frame in a random walk so grain does not alias to a static pattern; (2) anamorphic flare — a horizontal lens streak drawn as a radial gradient from each lantern node, angle locked to the 28°/18° light axiom, length proportional to lantern bloom amplitude; (3) colour punch — a curves LUT applied via pixel manipulation on a 1/4-resolution offscreen canvas every 4 frames (not every frame, for GPU economy), lifting #D49B42 midtones +12 points and deepening #09131E shadows -8 points; (4) material weave keyed to Futurist lens: a subtle interference-fringe pattern (two overlapping sine waves at 3.1px and 4.7px period, opacity 0.03) that reads as optical glass diffraction — no
proposals.motion: All motion is continuous state, not a sequence. GROUND plane: warm amber haze (#D49B42 at 8% opacity base) rises as a radial gradient from root-node positions; swell amplitude lifts gradient radius from 18% to 34% canvas height, spring-damped τ=0.32s — the ground breathes with the arrangement, never strobes. MID plane: eight olive trunk splines are static anchor geometry; 24 leaf cluster groups (4–7 ellipses each, cached as offscreen bitmaps) oscillate on independent sine phases (periods 3.1s–5.8s, amplitude ±2.4px lateral, ±0.8px vertical) — harmonic amplitude scales the oscillation amplitude coefficient from 0.6 to 1.4, so rich harmonic content produces visible leaf breath without position jitter. Lanterns (6 nodes) sway on pendulum physics (period 4.2s, damping 0.94) independent of audio — they sway because physics says they sway, not because the music tells them to; vocal amplitude c
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D renderer, 60fps rAF loop, integrated-GPU safe. Layer execution order per frame: (1) sky gradient fill (#09131E→#1E3A4C, vertical); (2) plate composite (offscreen canvas, multiply, dynamic plateBlend); (3) god-ray fans from light-axiom origin — 6 rays, each a clipped linear gradient, opacity 0.06–0.14 driven by swell; (4) ground haze radials; (5) trunk splines (Path2D, cached, redrawn only on resize); (6) leaf cluster bitmaps (drawImage from offscreen cache, transformed per oscillation state); (7) lantern nodes (arc + radial gradient bloom); (8) firefly points; (9) text-safe dimming band (fillRect with gaussian feather approximated by 3-stop shadow); (10) lyric typography (fillText, per-word opacity state machine); (11) scripture slug; (12) optical pass composites (grain scroll, flare streaks, LUT at 1/4 res). Audio pipeline: Web Audio API AnalyserNode, FFT 1024, three band-pass
proposals.humanTrace: The trunk spline control points are not algorithmically generated — they are transcribed from the concept plate's photographic trunk geometry, translated into Bezier coordinates by editorial decision. The light axiom angle (28°/18°) was read from the plate's lantern-cast shadow direction and locked as a shader uniform. The leaf oscillation phase offsets (seeded with irrational multiples of φ) were chosen so that no two clusters ever move in synchrony — a decision made by observation, not by algorithm. The haze lift timing (τ=0.32s) was tuned by listening to a reference worship recording and matching the felt breath of the room.
proposals.risk: The system refuses to be atmospheric in the traditional sense — there is no impressionistic blur, no painterly soft-focus, no glowing fog that 'feels' like Gethsemane. Everything is derived from a declared axiom or a physical rule. The risk is that a worship director expects warmth to feel warm and instead encounters a system that is correct. The counter-argument: correctness at 28°/18° produces a light that is warmer and more spatially coherent than any painted glow, because it is consistent across every element simultaneously — and a congregation at forty metres will feel the coherence without naming it.

arguesWith.why: The Baroque Dramatist will want the lantern bloom to surge on the vocal peak as a reveal — a crescendo of light that arrives as spectacle. I reject this because a bloom that jumps to maximum on a loud note and falls on silence is a visualizer, not a sanctuary. proposals.title: Lantern Light, Stone, Breath
proposals.idea: A documented place — the Garden of Gethsemane, terrace limestone, oil lanterns, thousand-year olive bark — rendered with the specificity of a field notebook and the restraint of a cartographer's hand, so that the congregation inhabits a named location, not an aesthetic.
proposals.geometry: Three explicit depth planes, each with a declared provenance role. Rear plane: the concept plate /sanctuary-plates/calm-olive-gethsemane.jpg composited at plateBlend (0.0–0.55), its edges vignetted by a soft radial gradient so the photographic record of the place anchors the scene without dominating. Mid plane: procedurally drawn gnarled olive trunks — not silhouettes but structural forms built from recursive Bézier strokes that honour the actual growth habit of Olea europaea var. sativa, the species documented at the Garden since the Byzantine period; trunks sit left-of-centre at roughly a 7:3 split, leaving the right third as the lyric column. Fore plane: hanging oil lanterns at three heights (upper-left cluster, mid-right single, lower-left pair) and a slow ground-haze layer. The lyric band occupies a horizontal register from 62% to 88% of screen height — a deliberate golden-section p
proposals.typography: Noto Serif for all lyric lines — chosen because it carries Hebrew, Greek, and Latin in the same optical weight and the Gethsemane texts exist in all three; this is not decorative multilingualism, it is the actual linguistic reality of the place. Size: 5.2vw at 1080p, scaling to 3.8vw at 4K so rear-pew legibility is maintained. Case: sentence case only — no ALL CAPS, which performs urgency this scene refuses. Tracking: +0.04em, loose enough to breathe, tight enough to read as a single phrase. Word-by-word progression: each word fades in at 220ms opacity ease-out, previous words dimming to 72% so the active word carries a 15% brighter warm-white (#FAF3E3 at full opacity vs. #D4C9A8 for settled words). Line transitions: outgoing line drops to 0% opacity over 380ms while incoming line rises; the two never overlap on screen simultaneously — one breath in, one breath out. No glow halos on text
proposals.imageLogic: The concept plate enters as the rear plane through a Canvas 2D globalCompositeOperation of 'source-over' at plateBlend, which the operator can set between 0.0 (fully procedural) and 0.55 (photograph strongly present). The plate is pre-cached as an ImageBitmap on load; it is never streamed or reloaded. A warm colour-grade is applied via a Canvas 2D filter string: sepia(0.18) brightness(0.82) saturate(1.12) — this pulls the plate toward the declared 3200K lantern key without washing out the 5800K indigo sky in the plate's upper register, so both declared light temperatures remain legible. The procedural mid-plane does not attempt to match the plate's olive trees; it sits in front of them at a slightly different scale and trunk angle, creating a layered parallax of two olive generations — the photographic record behind, the generative interpretation in front. This layering is the image logi
proposals.texture: The material weave for this lens is field-notebook paper — not decorative, but as a reminder that the most rigorous records of Gethsemane's olive trees (the 2012 National Geographic carbon-dating study placed six of the trees at 900–1000 years old) were made by people who sat with notebooks. Applied as: a procedurally generated fine-grain overlay at 4% opacity using Canvas 2D with a small-radius noise function (Perlin or value noise, seeded at load, not animated) drawn once to an offscreen canvas and composited as a cached texture tile. The grain is warm-tinted (#D49B42 at 3% opacity) in the lantern-lit lower third, neutral in the lyric band, and cooler (#1E3A4C at 4% opacity) in the sky upper third — three distinct material zones that correspond to the three declared light temperatures. No vignette darkness heavier than 40% at corners; this is not cinematic drama, it is documentary rest
proposals.motion: Everything moves slowly and with a declared physical cause. Vocal amplitude → lantern brightness: each lantern's radial gradient radius expands from base 48px to max 78px as vocal amplitude rises, with a 160ms ease-out spring (tension 0.12, friction 0.88) — no strobe, the spring damps any sharp attack. Firefly halos: six to nine small ellipses (4–7px radius) drift on independent Lissajous paths with periods between 8s and 22s; their opacity is modulated by vocal amplitude (base 0.18, max 0.52); they are not particles, they are individually addressed objects with named positions that do not reset between frames. Swell → ground haze: a layered set of four horizontal elliptical gradients in #D49B42 at low opacity (base 0.06, swell max 0.22) rise 12px over 2.4s and settle back; the motion is tidal, not smoky. Harmonic → olive leaf clusters: twelve to sixteen small ellipse groups (each 3–5 el
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D, 60fps, single render loop. Assets: one pre-cached ImageBitmap (the concept plate), one offscreen canvas (grain texture, drawn once at init), one offscreen canvas (olive trunk Bézier paths, drawn once at scene load and recomposited each frame at the correct z-order). Audio analysis: Web Audio API AnalyserNode, FFT size 2048; vocal band 200–3000Hz RMS for amplitude; swell band 60–200Hz for ground haze; harmonic band 3000–8000Hz for leaf motion. All envelopes smoothed with exponential moving average (α = 0.08 for rise, α = 0.04 for decay) to prevent any transient spike reaching the visual layer. Lantern radial gradients redrawn each frame with current radius; leaf cluster transforms applied via ctx.save/rotate/restore per cluster. Lyric engine: external JSON tick stream drives word reveal; opacity values written per word per frame. plateBlend exposed as a named operator control i
proposals.humanTrace: The olive trunk Bézier paths are not algorithmically generated from scratch each run — they are authored once by a human director (me, in this case) as a set of named control-point arrays stored in the kit's scene JSON, referencing the actual documented growth habit of millennial Olea europaea: low-branching, deeply fissured, counter-clockwise bark spiral. The control points are fixed; only the leaf-cluster rotation and lantern radius change at runtime. This means the trunks carry a human decision about where a branch forks, how wide the base flares, how far a root knuckle protrudes — decisions that cannot be automated without losing the specificity of the tree. The grain texture is seeded at load from a fixed integer (seed 1847, the year of the earliest surviving photographic record of the Garden of Gethsemane by Frédéric Goupil-Fesquet), so every instance of this visualizer generates t
proposals.risk: The restraint risks reading as sparse or underworked on a large LED wall where congregations expect visual richness. The absence of Cinzel, the refusal of symmetry, and the documentary grain may feel less 'worshipful' to operators accustomed to high-drama visualizers. The risk is worth it because Gethsemane is a specific place with a documented history, living trees, and a weight of meaning that generic grandeur would dilute; the congregation deserves to feel they are somewhere real, not somewhere designed.

proposals.title: The Garden Holds Its Breath
proposals.idea: A single declared lantern — physically warm, 3200K, positioned upper-left at 35° — conducts every shimmer, shadow offset, bokeh origin, and lyric glow in the scene, so that when the voice rises, it is not the renderer that brightens but the lantern itself that burns more deeply.
proposals.geometry: Three depth planes on a 16:9 stage, each with a distinct recession: Foreground — two massive gnarled olive trunks, one left-bleeding off-canvas, one anchoring right-center, rendered as silhouette volumes with procedural bark-crack detail; roots visible at bottom, dissolving into ground haze. Middle — terraced limestone wall, horizontal, running edge to edge at the golden-section horizon (56% from top), its mortar lines described by the 35° lantern shadow. Background — open indigo twilight sky, #09131E to #1E3A4C gradient, occupying the upper 44%. The lantern hangs from the left trunk at the horizon intersection — the compositional fulcrum where warm and cold, earth and sky, meet. No symmetry. The mass is weighted left; negative space breathes right. The lyric band occupies the lower 28% of the frame, below the limestone horizon, kept clear of the trunks.
proposals.typography: Cinzel, uppercase, tracked at +0.18em, weight 400. Single lyric line, centered, set at 3.2vw (≈ 62px at 1080p, ≈ 124px at 4K). Each word reveals sequentially on a 4–5 second line hold: words already spoken drop to 72% opacity and #FAF3E3 base; the arriving word blooms to 100% opacity with a 180ms ease-out, its text-shadow extending 0px to 12px amber (#D49B42 at 40% opacity) as vocal amplitude rises — the glow is the lantern's light reaching the words. No italic. No bold. No secondary sans line unless a scripture attribution is present; if present, Noto Serif at 1.4vw, regular, tracked +0.08em, #FAF3E3 at 55% opacity, 18px below the lyric baseline. The text-safe dimming band is a vertical gradient from transparent to #09131E at 55% opacity, occupying the lower 30% of the canvas, always rendered — the scene yields to the words by darkening the ground plane, not by shrinking the type.
proposals.imageLogic: The concept plate /sanctuary-plates/calm-olive-gethsemane.jpg enters as the scene's memory, not its surface. It is drawn first to an offscreen canvas at full resolution, then composited onto the main canvas at plateBlend (a 0.0–1.0 operator, default 0.22) using 'luminosity' composite mode — this means the plate's tonal geography (the specific way Gemini lit the bark, the wall grain, the leaf clusters) bleeds into the procedural scene as an inherited light memory rather than a photographic overlay. The plate is never visible as a photograph; it is felt as a rightness — the bark reads as that bark. At plateBlend above 0.35 (operator-adjustable), the plate's warm zones begin to visibly affirm the lantern's 35° cast, making the procedural and photographic light sources agree. The plate is cache-loaded once on init; no runtime fetch.
proposals.texture: Two material passes, both generative, both subordinate to the lantern's declared angle. First: limestone grain — a single 512×512 tileable noise texture, procedurally generated at init using a seeded Perlin field biased toward horizontal strata, drawn to an offscreen canvas once and tiled across the middle-ground wall. The lantern shadow at 35° is computed against this tile, giving the mortar lines directional shadow that agrees with the plate's inherited light. Second: olive bark — the trunk silhouettes carry a second Perlin-noise displacement field, amplitude ≈ 8px, which is the only geometry that moves under Harmonic (leaf sway), not the trunks themselves. Leaf clusters are procedural ellipse groups, silver-sage (#C8CFA8 interpolated toward #FAF3E3), 60–140px, layered 3 deep per cluster, sway driven by Harmonic channel at ±4° rotation with spring damping τ = 1.2s. Film grain: a single
proposals.motion: Everything moves at biological pace. The lantern flame: a candle-flicker shader (Canvas 2D radial gradient, center-point jitter within a 4px radius, luminosity oscillating between 0.82 and 1.0) driven by a Perlin oscillator seeded to 0.3–1.8 Hz — the actual frequency envelope of a burning oil flame. Vocal channel (amplitude smoothed, τ = 80ms): brightens the lantern radial gradient radius from 180px to 260px, lifts the lyric text-shadow amber glow from 0px to 12px, and increases firefly halo radius by +30%. Swell channel (low-frequency amplitude, τ = 400ms): lifts a ground-haze gradient (radial, #D49B42 at 0% to 8% opacity) upward through the root zone — not a particle system, a single animated gradient stop moving 0px to 40px vertically over 1.8s with ease-in-out. Harmonic channel (spectral brightness above 2kHz, τ = 200ms): drives leaf cluster rotation, ±4° per cluster, each cluster on
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D renderer, 60fps rAF loop on a single main canvas. Offscreen canvases: (1) plate blend canvas — concept plate drawn once, composited via luminosity; (2) limestone grain canvas — Perlin noise field, drawn once at init, tiled to middle-ground; (3) grain overlay canvas — pre-baked noise, composited as overlay each frame at 0.18 opacity. Render order per frame: sky gradient → plate blend (luminosity, plateBlend opacity) → background bokeh (indigo, large, static) → limestone wall + procedural shadow → trunk silhouettes left and right → leaf clusters (Harmonic-rotated) → ground haze gradient (Swell-lifted) → lantern glow (Vocal-scaled radial gradient) → firefly bokeh circles (Perlin drift) → film grain overlay → text-safe dimming band → lyric band (Cinzel, word-by-word, Vocal-glowed). All audio envelopes spring-damped. No particles. No WebGL. No video. Typefaces loaded via Google Font
proposals.humanTrace: The 35° lantern angle is a human decision entered once and honored by every downstream system — shadow offset, shimmer direction, bokeh origin, plate-blend luminosity agreement. The grain canvas is a seeded noise field whose seed is the visualizer's id number (001), meaning this specific garden has this specific texture and no other. The leaf cluster Perlin seeds are hand-assigned integers, not random, so the sway pattern of this grove is authored, not generated. The word-by-word lyric reveal timing is set per line by the operator, not by the audio — the voice illuminates, but the word arrives when the worship leader decides.
proposals.risk: The lantern-as-conductor architecture means that if the declared 35° angle and the concept plate's inherited light do not agree, the scene reads as two different gardens occupying the same canvas. The luminosity composite mode is the mechanism that resolves this — but it requires that the concept plate was itself lit from a plausible upper-left warm source. If the plate contradicts the declared angle, the plateBlend operator must be kept below 0.15 or the plate must be relit in the generative pipeline before delivery. This risk is worth taking because the alternative — a scene in which the procedural and photographic light sources are indifferent to each other — produces the exact flatness I will not defend.

arguesWith.why: The Minimalist will argue that eight firefly bokeh circles, three leaf-cluster depth layers, a limestone grain tile, a film grain overlay, and a ground-haze gradient are seven decisions too many — that one warm glow on black would carry the emotion. I disagree specifically and not generally: Gethsemane is not an abstraction. It is a garden with a specific species of tree, a specific quality of sto

proposals.title: One Stone, One Light
proposals.idea: Strip the garden to its irreducible geometry — a single limestone horizontal, one lantern, one trunk — so the congregation's eye has nowhere to rest except the word.
proposals.geometry: Three horizontal bands, proportioned on a 1:2:1 ratio top-to-mid-to-bottom: sky occupies the upper quarter; a single receding limestone terrace wall runs as one unbroken edge across the mid register at the golden section (≈ 61.8% from top); root mass and haze occupy the lower quarter. No diagonal energy, no radiating spokes. One olive trunk — procedurally generated from a Lindenmayer skeleton, heavy calligraphy-weight strokes, anchored left of centre at roughly 38% horizontal — acts as the only vertical. One hanging lantern, centred above the lyric band at ≈ 55% horizontal. Depth is achieved by value alone: three planes — far sky (#09131E), mid wall (#1E3A4C), near root haze (#D49B42 at 12% opacity) — never by parallax drift or competing motion vectors. The concept plate blends in at plateBlend opacity into the sky and wall planes only; root plane is fully procedural so the generative ha
proposals.typography: Noto Serif, roman weight only. One lyric line at a time, centred, set at a measure of no more than 22 characters per line. Size: 72px at 1080p (scales linearly to 4K). ALL CAPS suppressed — sentence case, first word capitalised. Tracking: +60/1000 em — wide enough to breathe, not so wide the eye loses the word as a unit. Baseline sits at 78% of frame height, inside the dimming band. Word-by-word reveal: each word fades in over 180 ms, holds, next word follows at 220 ms intervals — the pace of a slow exhalation, not a ticker. Active word: #FAF3E3 at full opacity. Already-spoken words: #FAF3E3 at 38% opacity, not hidden — they remain as the sentence's negative space. Line transition: outgoing line drops to 0% opacity over 600 ms with no motion — it simply ceases. Incoming line fades in from 0%, no slide, no scale. Scripture attribution line: Outfit Light, 13px at 1080p, #FAF3E3 at 45%, tra
proposals.imageLogic: The concept plate (/sanctuary-plates/calm-olive-gethsemane.jpg) enters through a multiply blend pass restricted to the sky-and-wall planes (top 75% of frame). plateBlend is a runtime parameter; at rest it sits at 0.28 — the photograph's limestone texture and indigo depth are legible but the plate never competes with the procedural lantern light. On vocal swell the blend holds; it does not brighten with audio — the plate is the fixed, ancient thing, and only the living light moves. The plate is drawn first, then covered by the procedural gradient sky (#09131E → #1E3A4C), which sits at 72% opacity, so the photograph shows through as memory rather than illustration. The root plane below the wall edge is fully procedural canvas path work — no plate pixel crosses that line. This keeps the photograph's photographic grain (5800K cool) structurally separated from the 3200K warm generative light,
proposals.texture: Material weave is linen — a fine horizontal-thread canvas pass, drawn once at startup as a cached offscreen bitmap (1920×1080), tiled, applied at 6% opacity over the entire frame as the final optical pass. Linen, not stone: stone would compete with the terrace wall's structural role; linen is the surface you lay on an altar, neutral, warm, tactile without speaking. Film grain: a single pre-rendered noise texture (OFL Shadertoy-class Perlin, baked to a 512×512 PNG at init), scrolled at 0.4 px/frame — slow enough to be subliminal, fast enough to read as breath rather than freeze. Grain opacity: 4% — present only for the eye that looks for it. No anamorphic flare on this card; the 35mm light-leak pass is a single warm amber (#D49B42 at 7%) vignette softly lifting the lantern's immediate halo, not a streak across the frame. One contrast does the work: the cool indigo plate against the warm p
proposals.motion: Order of motion, from stillest to most active — this is the editorial sequence, and nothing may break it: (1) The stone wall does not move. Ever. (2) The trunk does not move. Ever. (3) The lantern swings ±1.2° on a 7-second sinusoidal pendulum, spring-damped, Q=0.3 — perceptible only if you watch for it; it is the proof that time is passing, not a decorative gesture. (4) Fireflies: maximum eight points of light, each a soft radial gradient 4–8px radius, opacity 0.4–0.7, drifting on independent Perlin paths at 0.06–0.14 px/frame — below the threshold of saccade, above the threshold of stillness. (5) Vocal amplitude → lantern luminance only: the lantern's warm pool radius expands from 80px to 140px (smoothed, τ=220 ms) as vocal rises; firefly halos brighten proportionally. (6) Swell → ground haze: the amber mist layer (#D49B42 at base 8% opacity) lifts to 18% opacity, blur radius grows fro
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D, 60 fps, integrated GPU. Layer draw order: (1) sky gradient fill; (2) concept plate, multiply blend, clipped to top 75%; (3) procedural sky gradient overlay at 72% opacity; (4) limestone wall — a single canvas fillRect with a subtle horizontal noise edge (±3px Perlin jitter on the top edge, cached at init); (5) trunk — Lindenmayer path, drawn once, cached to offscreen canvas, composited; (6) leaf cluster sprites — eight offscreen canvases, each a pre-drawn polygon fan, transformed in place each frame by a single rotation matrix; (7) lantern — one radial gradient, centre recalculated each frame for audio-driven radius only; (8) firefly points — eight tiny radial gradients, positions updated via Perlin lookup; (9) ground haze — one radial gradient at root base, audio-driven opacity and blur via CSS filter on a dedicated layer canvas; (10) linen texture overlay — cached bitmap, fi
proposals.humanTrace: The trunk's Lindenmayer skeleton is seeded from a fixed random string — 'GETHSEMANE' as the axiom character sequence — so the branching structure is not arbitrary: it is derived from the name of the place. The leaf-cluster polygon fans are generated with a slight hand-tremor simulation (each vertex displaced by ±0.8px Gaussian noise baked at init), so they read as drawn, not computed. The lantern pendulum uses a physically-grounded damped oscillator (not a sine wave) so it settles the way a real hung lamp settles — the deceleration is asymmetric and human. These are the only three traces; everything else is geometry.
proposals.risk: The risk is that nothing happens. Eight fireflies and a swaying lantern and slow haze may read as broken to a worship leader expecting visual richness, or as cold to a congregation expecting warmth. The risk is worth carrying because the brief says 'never a screensaver' and the only reliable way to avoid screensaver is to remove everything that would be comfortable in a screensaver. What remains — stone, flame, word — is load-bearing. If the congregation is watching the fireflies, the direction has failed. If they are watching the word, it has succeeded. That is the only metric.

arguesWith.why: The Dramatist will read this scene as underlit and emotionally withheld — will want the lantern halo to bloom on every swell, the leaf clusters to cascade, the haze to rise dramatically, the light leak to streak. More structurally: the governing 35° angle is correctly declared prior to content, which I respect, but the text-safe dimming band is described as 'always rendered' at 55% opacity across the lower 30% of the canvas — that is a fixed darkening that precedes the light hierarc

The trunk that never moves and the wall that never moves are not human traces — they are a computer's idea of stillness, and fixing g
disputes.concession: The lantern pendulum built on a physically-grounded damped oscillator rather than a sine wave is the one motion in any of these proposals that is actually honest about what a hung lamp does — the asymmetric deceleration is a real physical argument, and I want that instead of the choreographed breath

disputes.objection: The 'luminosity' composite mode for the plate blend is the tell: calling it 'felt as a rightness' and 'inherited light memory' is poetry written to cover a parameters decision that has no stated rule — if the plate's tonal geography bleeds into the procedural scene, I need a transfer function, not a metaphor, and 'the bark reads as that bark' is not a specification, it is a mood. The entire motion section runs the same failure: 'biological pace' is declared as a governing principle but the actual output values — 180px to 260px lantern radius, 0px to 12px text-shadow — are chosen aesthetically and then narrated as if physics produced them. A system where the reveal is the experience and the r
disputes.concession: The single declared light source at 35° producing every downstream shadow offset, shimmer vector, and bokeh origin as derivable consequences is exactly the right generative axiom — that is a real system rule, and it is the strongest single structural decision on the table.

disputes.objection: The Futurist declares its 28°/18° light axiom was 'read from the plate's lantern-cast shadow direction' — but then immediately abstracts every material consequence into optical glass, interference-fringe diffraction, and LUT pixel manipulation, erasing the specific photographic origin it claims to honour. A Gethsemane garden reduced to anamorphic flare and sine-wave interference patterns is not a place anyone has been; it is a render pipeline wearing the garden's name as a label. The trunk splines transcribed from the plate's photographic geometry — the one genuinely grounded act in the proposal — then get redrawn as Canvas 2D Beziers, which severs the provenance chain the direction claims t
disputes.concession: The decision to let harmonic amplitude modulate plateBlend continuously — making the photographic plate more present as music swells with texture and receding in silence — is the most honest audio-visual argument on the table, and I would fight to keep it in any synthesis.

disputes.objection: A single trunk, a single lantern, and a wall that does not move is not restraint in service of the word — it is a stage with the curtain permanently half-drawn, afraid to commit to either scene or void. The congregation does not lean forward into stillness; they lean forward into contrast, into the moment before and the moment after, and this direction refuses to give them either — the lantern swings one degree and the fireflies drift below the threshold of saccade, which is not drama held in check but drama that never arrived. When the emotional weight of Gethsemane is the subject, a geometry that could as easily serve a minimalist hotel lobby is not a decision about the work — it is an abd
disputes.concession: The trunk seeded from the string 'GETHSEMANE' is a genuinely intelligent human-trace decision — a generative grammar whose axiom is the name of the place is exactly the kind of prior commitment that conducts everything downstream, and I wish more of this direction had that kind of declared meaning a

disputes.objection: The interference-fringe diffraction pattern at 0.03 opacity and the curves LUT applied every four frames are elements that cannot be seen and cannot be removed — they are complexity that hides behind the claim of subtlety, which is not the same as silence. Two sine waves at 3.1px and 4.7px period composited at three percent opacity contribute nothing a viewer can perceive and nothing the system can be caught cheating on; they are decoration that has learned to describe itself as physics. The light axiom is the right governing rule, but it is then joined by too many subordinate systems that each carry their own hidden logic, so the traceable constraint is buried under its own consequences.
disputes.concession: The decision to let lanterns sway on pendulum physics independent of audio — because physics says they sway, not because the music tells them to — is exactly the kind of prior structural commitment I would defend: one rule declared before the content, answerable to nothing but itself.

synthesis.direction: A single polar-origin lantern at 35° upper-right is declared before any content exists; every shadow offset, bokeh seed, amber haze rise, and lyric glow is a consequence of that one prior constraint. Three load-bearing depth planes at golden-section proportions (ground 0–38%, mid 38–76%, sky 76–100%) hold the scene as a classical three-register elevation, not a cinematic fade. The concept plate is composited rearmost at plateBlend via luminosity blend so its tonal geography bleeds into the procedural scene as inherited light — the plate's luminance grid (24×14 samples) seeds all bokeh mote and firefly halo positions, so every procedural glow inhabits a location the plate's painted light already authorises. Typography is Noto Serif sentence-case (not Cinzel) at 5.2vw, tracking +0.04em, word-by-word 180ms ease-out fade with a 2px upward spring-settle; active word at full #FAF3E3, settled words at 72%; the text-safe dimming band is a feathered horizontal slab at y 55–78%, its opacity computed per-frame against live scene brightness so the scene yields to the word rather than imposing a fixed dark floor. synthesis.keepFromCounterpoint: Harmonic amplitude drives plateBlend continuously (0.28 in silence → 0.48 at full harmonic swell), making the concept plate more photographically present as the music thickens with texture and receding when the room goes quiet — the photograph becomes the breath of the place, not a fixed substrate.
synthesis.editorCut: The Radical Minimalist removed three elements: (1) the anamorphic flare streak across lantern nodes — it read as a music-video optical effect, not a sanctuary optical pass, and the warm amber vignette lift does the same spatial work without the cinematic register; (2) the interference-fringe diffraction pattern at 0.03 opacity — two sine waves at 3.1px and 4.7px composited at three percent contribute nothing perceivable and add a subordinate logic system that obscures the declared 35° axiom rath
synthesis.openDecision: Lyric typeface register: Noto Serif sentence-case is the team's recommendation and my call — it carries the breath of a sung line without announcing itself. The Baroque Dramatist held for Cinzel uppercase, arguing that the congregational distance (five to forty metres) and the service gravity of Good Friday demand a titling weight. That argument is not wrong about distance; it is wrong about regis
synthesis.ariaSummary:
The team agreed on one thing before anything else: a single declared lantern at 35° has to conduct the whole scene — every shadow, every bokeh seed, every amber lift — or the visualizer becomes an accumulation of atmospheric effects rather than a unified act of light. That structural decision is the Classical lead, and I took it.

The sharpest disagreement was over the lyric typeface. The Baroque Dramatist wanted Cinzel uppercase — the monumental titling register — arguing that Good Friday at forty metres demands it. The Classical Mind pushed back: Cinzel is a Roman lapidary face, and placing it on a sung congregational lyric makes the type announce the text rather than carry it. I took the Classical side. The team is recommending Noto Serif sentence-case at 5.2vw — legible from the back pew, quiet enough to serve the singer.

The one thing I kept from the World-Eclectic counterpoint is the harmonic-driven plateBlend: the concept plate grows more photographically present as the music swells with texture and retreats in silence. The Futurist named it the most honest audio-visual argument on the table, and I agree — it means the ancient photograph and the procedural scene breathe together rather than sitting in fixed layers. The Radical Minimalist then cut three elements that were hiding behind claims of subtlety: the anamorphic flare streak, the interference-fringe diffraction pass, and the per-frame Perlin grain redraw. None of them were visible. All of them were costing frame budget.

The one decision that is yours: whether the lyric band runs in Noto Serif sentence-case or Cinzel uppercase. Everything else is set.

quotes.line: The temporal entry sequence was timed against a spoken reading of the first lyric line to confirm that the scene is fully resolved before a word appears.

The decision to let harmonic amplitude modulate plateBlend continuously — making the photographic plate more present as music swells with texture and receding in silence — is the most honest audio-visual argument on the table.
